cohort: The study included 623 mothers of children aged 6 to 12 months living in southern Ethiopia.
finding: The prevalence of sub-optimal breastfeeding practice was 60.2%, and it was significantly associated with maternal knowledge and attitude, paternal education, breastfeeding counseling, and Caesarean section delivery.
mod_finding: Caesarean section delivery was significantly associated with sub-optimal breastfeeding practice (AOR: 3.89; 95%CI 2.33-6.49).
cross-section timing: Data was collected from mothers when their children were aged 6 to 12 months.
